convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iMFI indicator with simple crossover entry logic, fixed pip SL/TP, and standard position sizing. No external libraries or custom indicators.

derived_values.name: Digit-adjusted point value for SL/TP calculation

other_exits: Opposite signal closes existing position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If Lots parameter is negative, uses fixed lot size (absolute value). If Lots parameter is positive, calculates lot size as fraction of free margin based on risk percent and SL distance.

custom_logic_notes: MFI slowdown strategy: enters long when MFI crosses above LevelLow (oversold recovery) and short when MFI crosses below LevelHigh (overbought reversal). The EA name 'Slowdown' refers to the MFI momentum deceleration at extremes. Position sizing is dual-mode: negative Lots=input means fixed lots, positive Lots=input means dynamic margin-based sizing. Signal reversal close is implicit - the position gate checks for no existing positions, meaning opposite positions must be closed first.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward conversion. MFI is available in most Python TA libraries (ta-lib, pandas-ta). Key considerations: 1) Digit adjustment for SL/TP must replicate the Digits==3||5 check, 2) New bar detection needs time-based comparison, 3) Dual-mode position sizing (negative=fixed, positive=margin-based) must be implemented, 4) Signal uses previous bar values [1] and [2] for crossover detection, not current bar [0].
